entities.summary: Major Ferdinand Baptista von Schill was a Prussian Army officer who revolted unsuccessfully against France's occupation of the Kingdom of Prussia in May 1809. Von Schill's uprising ended at the Battle of Stralsund, a battle which also saw von Schill's own death in action. Outnumbered 3 to 1, Schill's Prussian Freikorps succumbed to a Napoleonic force supported by Dutch and Danish auxiliaries.
